question.text: <math><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math> forms dimer in vapour phase but <math><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math> does not because

options.text: In  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></math>  there are vacant d orbitals in which it accommodates lone pair from chlorine atoms
In  <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math>  there is back bonding

There is hydrogen bonding in between two  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math>  molecules in vapour phase

solution.text: The formation of stronger backbond ( <math><mn>3</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi><mo>→</mo><mn>2</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></math>  overlap in  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math>   and weaker  <math><mn>3</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi><mo>→</mo><mn>3</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></math>  overlap in  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math> ) reduces the electron deficiency of the central atom and thus dimerisation tendency is reduced. So  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math>  can form a dimer but  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math>  and  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math>  cannot.
